metadata.purpose: Stage-H software/tool-chain development only; must be replaced by real VNA data for scientific validation.

models.S11: thin-wire center-fed finite-dipole induced-EMF approximation with sinusoidal current
models.S21_magnitude: Friis far-field transmission with broadside dipole directivity and 50-ohm mismatch at both ports

limitations: No cable, connector, balun/common-mode current, chamber reflection, manufacturing tolerance, conductor loss, or VNA calibration uncertainty.
Wire radius is an explicit surrogate assumption because production receiver geometry is not yet available.
Friis model is used only because 1.0 m exceeds the 2D^2/lambda far-field estimate over the full 200-500 MHz band.
Must not be used as experimental evidence or to close the VNA scientific-validation gate.
